bundle.name: specgen-agent-workflow-contracts
bundle.version_policy: semantic version; shared meaning changes require a new release and explicit migrations
public_api: immutable conformance fixtures and expected outcomes
public_api_exclusions: scheduler, worker launch, model selection, or execution
evaluation execution, review disposition, acceptance, or sealing
repository mutation, persistence, or generic CRUD

ownership.seam: schemas, IDs, normalization, validation, descriptors, digests, negotiation, migrations, conformance
canonical authoring, specification history, readiness, target compilation
prompt-pack interpretation, scheduling, role/model resolution, execution, lifecycle
